entities.name: Army of the Valley
entities.description: Army of the eastern Domains before the Brothers' War, formed after the destruction of Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Village whose destruction led to the army's formation.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Dragon freed after Mors Ridge's destruction who commanded a horde of undead and goblins.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Leader whose troops joined the army; killed in battle against Balgot.

entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Red Donald's daughter who became general of the army.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War after which the era followed.

events.summary: The Army of the Valley formed after Mors Ridge was destroyed and Palladia-Mors was freed; the town's remaining soldiers joined Red Donald's troops.
events.quote: The town's remaining soldiers joined with Red Donald 's troops.

events.summary: The army fought off Palladia-Mors's horde of undead and goblins, led by the orc general Balgot.
events.quote: led by the orc general Balgot

events.summary: Red Donald was killed in battle against Balgot and his daughter Ad'Amra became general.
events.quote: his daughter Ad'Amra became the general of the army

relations.note: Became general after her father's death
relations.quote: his daughter Ad'Amra became the general of the army
